fusions.name: Skitter Spray
fusions.desc: Scatters 3 loose strands spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Baseboard Run
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 5 tiles to a target and drives a strand through it for 14 damage.

fusions.name: Behind the Wainscot
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later and you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Small Hours
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
